Done. PR #141 is ready, green, and mergeable.

## Why attempt 1 didn't finish

It did the work and didn't publish it: the shader commit `7ce57a799b` was **never pushed**, the PR sat in **draft** with `Prediction: pending`, and NOTES.md still showed three unticked boxes the commit had actually done. From outside that's indistinguishable from a lane that got nowhere. That's now written up in `docs/lanes/linecap13/NOTES.md`.

## What attempt 2 changed

Two real defects, not just bookkeeping:

**`geom_dump/build/` was committed** — two generated `.c` files, three `.o`, and an 82 KB binary. `make` regenerates all six from `glsl/geom.c`, so a stale copy on disk reads exactly like the generator's current output. `psh_differ`, which this tool is modelled on, has a `.gitignore` for precisely that; `geom_dump` now does too, and `make clean && make run` rebuilds from nothing.

**The number attempt 1 was about to register was the wrong one.** The offline score takes a tie bias, and the choice moves the answer by more than the effect being measured:

| tie bias | before the clip | after | worse |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `1e-9` (geometry alone) | 414 px | 21 px | none |
| `1/256` (what the device pushes) | 935 px | 544 px | none |

`vk/draw.c`'s `geom_line_params()` sets `lineTieBias = 1/(2^subPixelPrecisionBits × scale)` and Adreno reports 8 bits — so 21 px is not a device prediction, and quoting it would have been off by 25×. The corroboration for the other column is that the model at `1/256` puts arm A at 935 px against the ~908 px the extent lane measured on a real device: within 3%, from a different instrument.

So leg C1 is registered as a **bound, ≤ 600 px** — it holds under either modelling of the tie while arm A's own ~908 does not, so it still separates "drawn and working" from "nothing happened". The residual ~544 px is the tie bias against the rasteriser's vertex quantisation, and I deliberately left it: that bias is pinned by the extent legs and isn't ours to retune.

## Definition of done

- Merged `origin/master` (88 commits behind → current), `preflight.sh --allow-tracker` **passes**, `selftest.sh` **313 passed, 0 failed**
- CI **green** on head `878b2fa5cc` (both builds + check)
- `Files:` line verified programmatically against `git diff --name-only origin/master...HEAD` — exact match, both directions
- Prediction `line-cap-clip.json` registered after the last merge, a_ref `415dcc6997` → b_ref `c8d2c22e14`, sha256 verified against the committed blob; all five `must_not_move` globs verified to match real goldens (13 + 1673)
- PR **marked ready**, labelled `harness`, reported on issue #13

One thing worth your attention: preflight caught a stale `nv2a_index.json`, and regenerating it also fixed **seven `gl/shaders.c` sites that were already stale on master** (off by 91 lines) — so that staleness predates this lane and was sitting in master. I confirmed `provenance.tests_commit` matched the local tests tree first, and counts were identical before and after (951/2833/103), so no suite was silently dropped.
